name: nexus-anomaly-detection-api

description_variants.claude: Detect anomaly root causes in multivariate time series by computing causal propagation graphs using Normalized Mutual Information and Transfer Entropy.
description_variants.gpt: Tool for anomaly detection and causal origin tracing in multidimensional time series, returning directed graphs with NMI and Transfer Entropy weights.
description_variants.gemini: Use anomaly causal map to pinpoint the source sensor or variable that triggered an anomaly, leveraging NMI and Transfer Entropy to reveal directed dependencies.

value_equivalent: $150 per hour of manual work saved
invocation_examples: When did the anomaly start and which variable was the first to deviate? Show me the causal chain.
Analyze this multivariate sensor stream and return the directed graph of anomaly propagation with Transfer Entropy edge weights.
Query the anomaly causal origin for the last 2 hours and output the AnomalyCausalMap as JSON.
